Many Hindu devotional songs and hymns refer to Lord Narayan as the ultimate deity and source of truth and wisdom.

The name Narayan is considered sacred and holds immense spiritual significance for millions of Hindus around the world.

He was a strong opponent of the Muslim League and its demand for a separate Muslim state. Narayanlal also supported the Non-Cooperation and Civil Disobedience movements led by Mahatma Gandhi, and was imprisoned several times for his activism.
